note: label a clip with: python3 eval/annotate_real_clip.py --clip <dir> --sidecar <this file> -- which replays applied_log (what the renderer was SHOWN). Without that log the annotator can only model pose_at(frame.stamp_sim_s - t0_sim_s), which is what the driver ASKED for and lands ~0.4-0.8 s ahead of the render.
